runs.t: API versioning manages incompatible contract changes without unexpectedly breaking clients. Many changes can remain backward-compatible and do not require a new version number.

Differentiate additive fields from removed fields, changed semantics and renamed enum values. Choose URI, header or media-type approaches deliberately; define a deprecation window, usage telemetry and migration path.
A booking API introducing cancellation reasons may add an optional field in v1. Changing monetary units from cents to floating currency amounts is incompatible and needs a safer migration.
Versioning cannot compensate for undocumented behavior. Too many simultaneously supported versions multiply testing and security work; sunset unused versions with clear communication.

Вимагайте перевірювані докази: тести, вимірювання або обґрунтування проєктного рішення.
